dataset.title: SNAPSHOT USA 2024: Year 6 of the coordinated national camera trap survey of the United States

spatial_contract.site_selection: among eligible unique sites with Longitude >= -105, sort ascending by SHA256('snapshot-usa-2024-r5b-v1|' + spatial_unit) and take first 64
spatial_contract.east_holdout_rule: sort selected sites by Longitude; start with easternmost ceil(0.20*N); if the westernmost heldout longitude is tied with training, move all sites at that longitude into heldout
spatial_contract.strict_separation_required: max training Longitude < min heldout Longitude

buckets.role: PresenceOnly-like counts; deployment effort deliberately not supplied to this stream
PresenceOnly-like counts with deployment-derived explicit effort
StateAnnotatedCount-like counts informing activity and solitary/group state
StateCompositionCount-like conditional labels; consumes state only

temporal_contract.timestamp_interpretation: camera-local civil time as supplied by SNAPSHOT USA
temporal_contract.context: spatial_unit x ISO week x six-hour bin
temporal_contract.doy: day-of-year of the Thursday midpoint of the ISO week, clipped to calendar year
temporal_contract.effort_reconstruction: deployment active fraction = Survey_Nights / inclusive calendar nights between Start_Date and End_Date; distribute that fraction across calendar days and four six-hour bins so total camera-day effort equals Survey_Nights

environment_contract.eastness: Longitude standardized using training selected sites only
environment_contract.latitude: Latitude standardized using training selected sites only

precipitation.next_stage_requirement: pin a public daily precipitation product/version and cache input hashes before sequence response rows are opened

response_opening_prerequisites: deployment file full-byte transport succeeds and SHA256 is frozen
sequence header is captured without reading a response data row
all required columns match the frozen schema
at least 64 eligible unique sites exist east of -105 longitude
exact 64-site selection and exact east holdout are frozen from deployment metadata
all four training stream deployment partitions are non-empty
precipitation source/product/version and covariate-cache procedure are frozen
